critique: The deep aubergine ground, lavender aura, restrained gold, and serif/sans pairing are cohesive, and the four menu cards share a clear construction system. The hero illustration is less resolved: concentric circle strokes vary between solid and dashed without material rationale, and the central spirit is a very flat faceted silhouette whose tiny eyes and abrupt lower points feel unfinished beside the elegant typography. Star texture is extremely faint and unevenly clipped. Menu-card secondary labels and eyebrow text are too low contrast, card accent glyphs use unrelated stroke/fill styles, and the selected card's purple surface is much flatter and brighter than the translucent dark cards. The header gold counter uses a different border density and corner treatment from the menu.
suggestion: Refine the hero as one coherent mystical illustration: use a consistent sigil stroke hierarchy, controlled glow falloff, and a more precisely shaded spirit silhouette with clean facial and lower-edge geometry. Establish shared tokens for panel border, translucent surface, selected state, gold accent, and shadow, then apply them to the currency counter and all menu cards. Redraw the four card glyphs with one size, stroke weight, and optical alignment; raise small-label contrast and standardize tracking. Make the selected card an elevated variant of the same material rather than a separate flat purple block, and cleanly bound the star texture within safe margins.
audit_note: Direct independent visual critique from the r0 screenshot and brief only; no generation notes, HTML, other critics, revisions, or scores were inspected.
